'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Eastern Ukraine offensive]]
****[[Siege of Mariupol]]
*****The [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Russian defence ministry]] claims that around 1,000 [[Ukrainian Naval Infantry|Ukrainian marines]] have surrendered to [[Russia]]. Ukraine makes no comment. [https://www.rferl.org/a/ukraine-marines-surrender-russia-mariupol/31801246.html (Rferl)]
***[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Foreign aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
****The [[United States]] says that it is sending an additional [[$]]800 million in military aid to [[Ukraine]], as well as heavy weapons, including [[artillery]] systems, artillery rounds, [[armored personnel carrier]]s, [[Mil Mi-17|Mi-17 helicopters]] transferred from [[Afghanistan]], 300 [[AeroVironment Switchblade|Switchblade drones]] and [[unmanned surface vehicle]]s for coastal defence. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/us-announces-additional-800-million-military-aid-ukraine-2022-04-13/ (Reuters)]
****Russian deputy foreign minister [[Sergei Ryabkov]] says [[United States|U.S.]] and [[NATO]] vehicles transporting weapons on Ukrainian territory are "legal military targets". [https://www.reuters.com/world/russia-says-us-nato-weapon-transports-ukraine-are-legitimate-targets-2022-04-13/ (Reuters)]
***[[Northern Ukraine campaign|Northeastern Ukraine offensive]]
****[[Governor of Kharkiv Oblast]] [[Oleh Synyehubov]] says that seven people have been killed and 22 others have been injured in the [[oblasts of Ukraine|oblast]] during the past 24 hours. [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-704038 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
***[[Kyiv offensive (2022)|Kyiv offensive]]
****The [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Russian defence ministry]] says it will begin to target [[Ukrainians|Ukrainian]] "decision-makers", including [[President of Ukraine|President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]], and command centres in the capital [[Kyiv]] if Ukrainian forces continue to attack Russian territory. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/will-strike-decision-making-centres-if-russias-ominous-warning-to-ukraine-2886621 (NDTV)]
***Presidents [[Andrzej Duda]] of [[Poland]], [[Gitanas Nausėda]] of [[Lithuania]], [[Egils Levits]] of [[Latvia]], and [[Alar Karis]] of [[Estonia]] arrive in [[Kyiv]] and meet with [[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian president]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]]. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-putin-kyiv-business-europe-afc276faff040e7bf0b87b7625adbba8 (AP)]
***The [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian military]] says that it has struck the [[Russian Navy]]'s [[Russian cruiser Moskva|cruiser ''Moskva'']] with [[Neptune (cruise missile)|Neptune]] [[anti-ship missile]]s hours after the warship was reported to be on fire in the [[Black Sea]]. [https://www.fbcnews.com.fj/world/russian-flagship-cruiser-hit-by-ukrainian-rockets/ (FCB News)] [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/russian-warship-destroyed-after-missile-strike-in-black-sea-ukraine-says-2886806 (NDTV)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**The [[Israel Defense Forces]] raid the city of [[Nablus]] in the [[West Bank]], killing one person and injuring 31 others. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/4/13/israeli-forces-kill-palestinian-in-nablus-amid-ongoing-raids (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Insurgency in Cabo Delgado]]
**[[South Africa]] says that it is extending its participation in a [[Southern African Development Community Mission in Mozambique|multinational counter-insurgent coalition]] in [[Mozambique]]. [https://apnews.com/article/south-africa-southern-lesotho-pretoria-097d65f7a792e27cb94535b7e45576ca (AP)]
*[[Nigerian bandit conflict]], [[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**[[Nigeria]] says it has uncovered an [[alliance]] between bandit gangs and the [[Islamist]] [[Boko Haram]] group. [https://apnews.com/article/business-abuja-nigeria-africa-ad98d9ce0464680fadb27728eea36001 (AP)]
*[[Insurgency in the Maghreb]]
**[[Jihadist insurgency in Niger]]
***Four [[National Guard of Niger|gendarmes]] and seven  border police are killed in a series of attacks by [[jihadist]] [[militant]]s. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/armed-men-kill-11-security-force-members-niger-attacks-government-says-2022-04-13/ (Reuters)] 

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Wildfires in 2022]]
**[[2022 New Mexico wildfires]]
***Two people are killed and 200 homes are reportedly damaged during the [[McBride Fire]] in [[Ruidoso, New Mexico|Ruidoso]], [[New Mexico]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2022/04/14/us/new-mexico-wildfire-deaths.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.dps.nm.gov/index.php/news-releases/item/1248-nmsp-investigates-deceased-victims-in-the-mcbride-fire-in-ruidoso-nm (NMDPS)]
*[[2022 KwaZulu-Natal floods]]
**The death toll from the [[flood]]s in [[KwaZulu-Natal]], [[South Africa]], during the last five days increases to 300. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-61092334 (BBC News)]
*[[List of earthquakes in 2022|Earthquakes in 2022]]
**A 6.3 magnitude [[list of earthquakes in Papua New Guinea|earthquake]] hits the [[Papua New Guinea]]n island of [[New Britain]]. [https://www.canberratimes.com.au/story/7698787/magnitude-63-quake-strikes-png/ (''Canberra Times'')]
*Ten people are killed and 14 others are injured when a truck crashes into a [[tourism in Egypt|tourist]] bus in [[Aswan Governorate]], [[Egypt]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/bus-crash-egypt-kills-10-including-french-belgian-84052581 (ABC News)]
*Eighteen people are killed when a truck carrying 29 people flips over in [[Indonesia]]'s [[West Papua (province)|West Papua]] [[provinces of Indonesia|province]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/truck-carrying-miners-indonesia-flips-over-killing-18-2022-04-13/ (Reuters)]
*Twenty-eight people are dead after a boat capsizes in [[Sokoto State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.pulse.ng/news/metro/26-persons-die-as-boat-capsizes-in-sokoto/5es2jr4 (pulse NG)] [https://www.peacefmonline.com/pages/local/news/202204/464550.php (PeaceFM)]
*Six people are dead and 13 more injured during a fire at a pharmaceutical factory in [[Andhra Pradesh]], [[India]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/asia/india/hyderabad-akkireddygudem-factory-explosion-gas-leak-b2057902.html (''Independent'')]
'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****The [[Centers for Disease Control and Prevention|U.S. CDC]] and [[Transportation Security Administration|TSA]] announce that they have extended the mask mandate for [[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on public transport|public transportation]] until May 3. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/transportation/2022/04/13/transportation-airplane-mask-mandate-extended/ (''The Washington Post'')] [https://thehill.com/policy/transportation/3266320-tsa-extending-travel-mask-mandate-for-two-weeks/ (''The Hill'')]
***[[United States Secretary of Health and Human Services|U.S. Health and Human Services secretary]] [[Xavier Becerra]] announces that the [[Presidency of Joe Biden|Biden administration]] has extended the [[COVID-19]] [[state of emergency]] for 90 days. The state of emergency was expected to expire on April 16. [https://rollcall.com/2022/04/13/administration-extends-public-health-emergency-for-90-days/ (''Roll Call'')]
*[[Abortion in the United States]]
**[[Abortion in Kentucky]]
***A bill banning [[abortion]] after 15 weeks of gestation (styled on [[Mississippi]]'s bill) and restricting its access to minors comes into force after the [[Kentucky Legislature|legislature]] overrides [[Governor of Kentucky|Governor]] [[Andy Beshear]]'s veto. [https://wfpl.org/ky-house-overrides-gov-beshears-veto-on-omnibus-anti-abortion-bill/ (WFPL)]

'''International relations'''
*[[English Channel migrant crossings (2018–present)|English Channel migrant crossings]]
**The [[Government of the United Kingdom|British government]] and [[Rwanda]] agree on a deal to relocate [[Illegal immigration|illegal migrants]] who arrive on boats in the [[United Kingdom]] to processing centres in Rwanda. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-61097114 (BBC News)]
*[[Enlargement of NATO]]
**[[Prime Minister of Finland|Finnish prime minister]] [[Sanna Marin]] says [[Finland]] will decide on [[NATO]] membership within "weeks", after [[Russia]] warned the country against joining the [[Western world|Western]] military alliance. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-61093302 (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2022 New York City Subway attack]]
**The suspect in yesterday's [[mass shooting]] and [[smoke bomb]] attack at the [[New York City Subway]] that injured 23 people is arrested following a tip from bystanders. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-61100179 (BBC News)]
*[[The Walt Disney Company|Disney]] announces that it shut down ''[[Club Penguin Rewritten]]'', which was seen as a successor to the defunct ''[[Club Penguin]]'', over concerns of [[copyright infringement]]. Assets are seized by the [[Police Intellectual Property Crime Unit]]. Three people are arrested in [[London]], [[United Kingdom]] on suspicion of distributing materials infringing copyright. [https://www.dexerto.com/entertainment/disney-shuts-down-club-penguin-rewritten-over-copyright-three-people-arrested-1803909/?amp (Dexerto)]
